newsitem.title: ITALY: Stefanel, Calvin Klein open first jv unit.
newsitem.headline: Stefanel, Calvin Klein open first jv unit.

text.p: Italian clothing group Stefanel and U.S. designer Calvin Klein opened a shop in Milan on Wednesday set to be the first in a series of joint outlets in Europe and the Middle East selling the CK Calvin Klein line.

Under their SKY Company Spa joint venture, which is 73 percent Stefanel owned and 27 percent Calvin Klein Inc, the two intend to open outlets in Riyadh, Kuwait City in April, Tel Aviv and Moscow in July, London, Lisbon, Barcelona and Jeddah from September, a SKY Company statement said.

SKY Company has the licence to produce and distribute Calvin Klein's second line CK Calvin Klein for men and women and will operate on the European and Middle East markets where it plans another 15 store openings in 1998.
Production is managed by K Services Spa, 100 percent owned by Stefanel and specifically set up for CK Calvin Klein.
Distribution is restricted to a limited number of multibrand outlets as well as the planned network of freestanding CK stores like the one opening in Milan this week, the statement said.

SKY Company will have a turnover of 70 billion lire in 1997 and expects to break even this year after start-up costs. It aims for sales of 200 billion by 2000, Stefanel chairman Giuseppe Stefanel said at a presentation.
The company intends to invest between 40 and 50 billion lire in the next three years, Stefanel said.
